Create a Ponder token under your control and a Frailty token under each opponent's control.
Go again

codex_of_inertia.text_zh:
每位英雄将其牌库顶的一张牌牌面朝下放入其军械库。每位以此方式做法的英雄弃一张牌。
在你控制下创造一个沉思衍生物，并在每位对手的控制下创造一个惰性衍生物。
再动
codex_of_inertia.text_en:
Each hero puts the top card of their deck face down into their arsenal. Each hero that does, discards a card.
Create a Ponder token under your control and an Inertia token under each opponent's control.
Go again

coercive_tendency.text_zh:
阿拉克尼专精
查看防御英雄牌库顶的3张牌。以任意顺序放回，然后放逐其牌库顶的一张牌。
若你以此方式完成一份契约，本战斗链中你的刺客攻击获得再动。
coercive_tendency.text_en:
Arakni Specialization
Look at the top 3 cards of the defending hero's deck. Put them back in any order, then banish the top card of their deck.
If you complete a contract this way, your Assassin attacks get go again this combat chain.

cog_in_the_machine.text_zh:
创造2个金齿轮衍生物。
你可以横置你控制的一个齿轮。若如此做，将此牌置于其拥有者的牌库底。
cog_in_the_machine.text_en:
Create 2 Golden Cog tokens.
You may {t} a cog you control. If you do, put this on the bottom of its owner's deck.

cognition_field.text_zh: 激励——当此牌防御时，你可以摧毁你控制的一个物品。若如此做，此牌获得+2防御。
cognition_field.text_en: Galvanize - When this defends, you may destroy an item you control. If you do, this gets +2{d}.

cognition_nodes.text_zh:
行动——支付1点资源：若认知节点上没有蒸汽指示物，在其上放置一个蒸汽指示物。再动
每回合一次攻击反应——从认知节点上移除一个蒸汽指示物：目标攻击行动牌获得“当此牌命中时，将其置于其拥有者的牌库底。”
cognition_nodes.text_en:
Action - {r}: If there are no steam counters on Cognition Nodes, put a steam counter on it. Go again
Once per Turn Attack Reaction - Remove a steam counter from Cognition Nodes: Target attack action card gains "When this hits, put it on the bottom of its owner's deck."

cogwerx_base_arms.type_zh: 机械师 装备·基础 手臂
cogwerx_base_arms.text_zh:
当此牌被装备时，在其上放置一个蒸汽指示物。
每回合一次瞬间——支付1点资源，从此牌上移除一个蒸汽指示物：你本回合的下一次机械师攻击获得+1力量。仅当本回合你推进过时才能启动此异能。
cogwerx_base_arms.text_en:
When this is equipped, put a steam counter on it.
Once per Turn Instant - {r}, remove a steam counter from this: Your next Mechanologist attack this turn gets +1{p}. Activate this ability only if you've boosted this turn.

cogwerx_base_chest.type_zh: 机械师 装备·基础 胸部
cogwerx_base_chest.text_zh:
当此牌被装备时，在其上放置一个蒸汽指示物。
每回合一次瞬间——支付1点资源，从此牌上移除一个蒸汽指示物：获得2点资源。仅当本回合你推进过时才能启动此异能。
cogwerx_base_chest.text_en:
When this is equipped, put a steam counter on it.
Once per Turn Instant - {r}, remove a steam counter from this: Gain {r}{r}. Activate this ability only if you've boosted this turn.

cogwerx_base_head.type_zh: 机械师 装备·基础 头部
cogwerx_base_head.text_zh:
当此牌被装备时，在其上放置一个蒸汽指示物。
每回合一次瞬间——支付1点资源，从此牌上移除一个蒸汽指示物：将你放逐区中的一张机械师攻击行动牌洗入你的牌库。仅当本回合你推进过时才能启动此异能。
cogwerx_base_head.text_en:
When this is equipped, put a steam counter on it.
Once per Turn Instant - {r}, remove a steam counter from this: Shuffle a Mechanologist attack action card from your banished zone into your deck. Activate this ability only if you've boosted this turn.

cogwerx_base_legs.type_zh: 机械师 装备·基础 腿部
cogwerx_base_legs.text_zh:
当此牌被装备时，在其上放置一个蒸汽指示物。
每回合一次瞬间——支付1点资源，从此牌上移除一个蒸汽指示物：获得1个行动点。仅当本回合你推进过时才能启动此异能。
cogwerx_base_legs.text_en:
When this is equipped, put a steam counter on it.
Once per Turn Instant - {r}, remove a steam counter from this: Gain 1 action point. Activate this ability only if you've boosted this turn.

cogwerx_blunderbuss.text_zh:
行动——支付2点资源，横置此牌：攻击
瞬间——横置你控制的一个齿轮：此牌本回合的下一次攻击获得再动。
cogwerx_blunderbuss.text_en:
Action - {r}{r}, {t}: Attack
Instant - {t} a cog you control: This card's next attack this turn gets go again.

cogwerx_dovetail.text_zh:
当此牌命中英雄时，重置你控制的所有齿轮。
每回合三次瞬间——横置你控制的一个齿轮：此牌获得+1力量或再动。
cogwerx_dovetail.text_en:
When this hits a hero, {u} all cogs you control.
Thrice per Turn Instant - {t} a cog you control: This gets +1{p} or go again.

cogwerx_tinker_rings.text_zh:
当此牌防御时，创造一个金齿轮衍生物。
刃碎
cogwerx_tinker_rings.text_en:
When this defends, create a Golden Cog token.
Blade Break

cogwerx_workshop.text_zh:
创造一个金齿轮衍生物。
在你控制的至多2个齿轮上放置一个蒸汽指示物。
cogwerx_workshop.text_en:
Create a Golden Cog token.
Put a steam counter on up to 2 cogs you control.

cogwerx_zeppelin.text_zh:
当此牌命中英雄时，你可以横置你控制的一个齿轮。若如此做，创造一个金齿轮衍生物。
每回合两次瞬间——横置你控制的一个齿轮：此牌获得+1力量。
cogwerx_zeppelin.text_en:
When this hits a hero, you may {t} a cog you control. If you do, create a Golden Cog token.
Twice per Turn Instant - {t} a cog you control: This gets +1{p}.

cold_snap.text_zh:
目标英雄可以支付3点资源。若该英雄不支付，冻结其军械库中的一张牌或其控制的一个盟友，直到你的下一个回合开始。
若骤寒是从军械库使用的，抽一张牌。
再动
cold_snap.text_en:
Target hero may pay {r}{r}{r}. If they don't, freeze a card in their arsenal or an ally they control until the start of your next turn.
If Cold Snap is played from arsenal, draw a card.
Go again

cold_wave.type_zh: 元素 游侠 行动·箭矢 攻击
cold_wave.text_zh:
冰融合
若寒潮已融合，本回合牌和启动式异能对对手英雄而言额外消耗1点资源。
cold_wave.text_en:
Ice Fusion
If Cold Wave was fused, cards and activated abilities cost opposing heroes an additional {r} this turn.

collapsing_trap.type_zh: 游侠 防御反应·陷阱
collapsing_trap.text_zh:
传奇瑞普泰德专精
当此牌防御具有再动的攻击时，攻击英雄弃掉其手牌，然后抽数量减1的牌。
collapsing_trap.text_en:
Legendary Riptide Specialization
When this defends an attack with go again, the attacking hero discards their hand then draws that many cards minus 1.

colors_of_aria.text_zh: 当此牌正面朝上位于任何区域时，它同时具有大地、冰和闪电属性。
colors_of_aria.text_en: While this is face-up in any zone, it's Earth, Ice, and Lightning.

colossal_bearing.text_zh: 塔盾——若此牌的力量为13或更高，它获得“当此牌命中英雄时，摧毁其控制的防御为1或更低的一件装备。”
colossal_bearing.text_en: Tower - If this has 13 or more {p}, it gets "When this hits a hero, destroy an equipment they control with 1 or less {d}."

combustible_courier.text_zh:
若易燃信使命中，本战斗链中你推进的下一次攻击获得+3力量。
推进
combustible_courier.text_en:
If Combustible Courier hits, the next attack you boost this combat chain gains +3{p}.
Boost

combustion_point.type_zh: 龙裔 忍者 攻击反应
combustion_point.text_zh:
目标龙裔或忍者攻击行动牌获得+1力量。
你可以放逐一张防御小于你控制的龙裔链环数量的非装备防御牌。
combustion_point.text_en:
Target Draconic or Ninja attack action card gains +1{p}.
You may banish a non-equipment defending card with {d} less than the number of Draconic chain links you control.

come_to_fight.text_zh:
你本回合使用的下一张攻击行动牌获得+3力量。
再动
come_to_fight.text_en:
The next attack action card you play this turn gains +3{p}.
Go again

comeback_kicks.text_zh:
每当观众为你欢呼时，若你的生命低于其他每位英雄，你可以摧毁此牌。若如此做，获得1个行动点。
战痕
comeback_kicks.text_en:
Whenever the crowd cheers you, if you have less {h} than each other hero, you may destroy this. If you do, gain 1 action point.
Battleworn

comeback_kid.text_zh:
当此牌攻击英雄时，若你的生命低于该英雄，观众为你欢呼。
若本回合你被欢呼过，此牌获得+1力量。
comeback_kid.text_en:
When this attacks a hero, if you have less {h} than them, the crowd cheers you.
If you've been cheered this turn, this gets +1{p}.

comet_collision.type_zh: 闪电 法师 瞬间
comet_collision.text_zh:
对任意目标造成3点秘法伤害。
星落——若本回合有一张瞬间牌被置入你的坟场，改为造成4点秘法伤害。
comet_collision.text_en:
Deal 3 arcane damage to any target.
Starfall - If an instant card has been put into your graveyard this turn, instead deal 4 arcane damage.

comet_storm_shock.type_zh: 法师 行动·闪电 瞬间
comet_storm_shock.text_zh:
凝合
对任意目标造成5点秘法伤害。
//
对任意目标造成1点秘法伤害。
comet_storm_shock.text_en:
Meld
Deal 5 arcane damage to any target.
//
Deal 1 arcane damage to any target.

command_and_conquer.text_zh: 防御反应牌不能在此链环中使用。当此牌命中英雄时，摧毁其军械库中的所有牌。
command_and_conquer.text_en: Defense reaction cards can't be played this chain link. When this hits a hero, destroy all cards in their arsenal.

command_respect.text_zh: 当此牌命中英雄时，若此牌的力量大于其基础，摧毁其军械库中的一张牌。
command_respect.text_en: When this hits a hero, if this has {p} greater than its base, destroy a card in their arsenal.

commanding_performance.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次战士攻击获得+3力量。
直到回合结束，你的战士攻击获得“当此牌被1张或更多攻击行动牌防御时，摧毁防御英雄军械库中的一张牌。”
再动
commanding_performance.text_en:
Your next Warrior attack this turn gets +3{p}. 
Until end of turn, your Warrior attacks get "When this is defended by 1 or more attack action cards, destroy a card in the defending hero's arsenal."
Go again

companion_of_the_claw.type_zh: 秘法 忍者 行动·攻击
companion_of_the_claw.text_zh:
当此牌攻击时，若本回合你资源过一张蓝色牌，在你的手牌中创造一张卧虎。
再动
companion_of_the_claw.text_en:
When this attacks, if you've pitched a blue card this turn, create a Crouching Tiger in your hand.
Go again

compass_of_sunken_depths.type_zh: 海盗 Necromancer 装备·副手
compass_of_sunken_depths.text_zh:
瞬间——横置此牌：查看你牌库顶的一张牌。
每回合你从坟场中使用的第一张具有水葬的牌获得再动。
compass_of_sunken_depths.text_en:
Instant - {t}: Look at the top card of your deck.
The first card with watery grave you play from your graveyard each turn gets go again.

compounding_anger.text_zh: 每当你控制一个龙裔链环，此牌的使用费用减少1点资源。
compounding_anger.text_en: This costs {r} less to play for each Draconic chain link you control.

concealed_blade.type_zh: 刺客·忍者 攻击反应
concealed_blade.text_zh: 目标刺客或忍者攻击行动牌获得+1力量，以及“当此牌命中时，从你的物品栏装备一把匕首。”
concealed_blade.text_en: Target Assassin or Ninja attack action card gains +1{p} and "When this hits, equip a dagger from your inventory."

concealed_nerve_gas.type_zh: 游侠 装备·胸部 陷阱
concealed_nerve_gas.text_zh:
翳装
当此牌牌面朝下装备时，当具有再动的攻击命中你时，摧毁此牌，并在每位对手的控制下创造一个虚弱衍生物。
concealed_nerve_gas.text_en:
Cloaked
While this is equipped face-down, when an attack with go again hits you, destroy this and create a Frailty token under each opponent's control.

concealed_object.text_zh:
当此牌进入竞技场时，观众为你喝倒彩。
瞬间——横置此牌：目标攻击获得+1力量。
在你的结束阶段开始时，摧毁此牌。
concealed_object.text_en:
When this enters the arena, the crowd boos you.
Instant - {t}: Target attack gets +1{p}.
At the beginning of your end phase, destroy this.

concealed_pathogen.type_zh: 游侠 装备·胸部 陷阱
concealed_pathogen.text_zh:
翳装
当此牌牌面朝下装备时，当攻击命中你且其操控者在此链环中使用或启动过攻击反应时，摧毁此牌，并在每位对手的控制下创造一个血腐疫病衍生物。
concealed_pathogen.text_en:
Cloaked
While this is equipped face-down, when an attack hits you and its controller has played or activated an attack reaction this chain link, destroy this and create a Bloodrot Pox token under each opponent's control.

concealed_sedative.type_zh: 游侠 装备·胸部 陷阱
concealed_sedative.text_zh:
翳装
当此牌牌面朝下装备时，当力量大于其基础的攻击命中你时，摧毁此牌，并在每位对手的控制下创造一个惰性衍生物。
concealed_sedative.text_en:
Cloaked
While this is equipped face-down, when an attack with {p} greater than its base hits you, destroy this and create an Inertia token under each opponent's control.

concoct_disorder.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，每位英雄将其牌库顶的一张牌牌面朝下放入其军械库。若以此方式有2张或更多牌被放入军械库，此牌获得再动。
concoct_disorder.text_en: When this attacks, each hero puts the top card of their deck face-down into their arsenal. If 2 or more cards are put into arsenals this way, this gets go again.

concuss.text_zh: 当此牌命中英雄时，若此牌的力量大于其基础，该英雄弃一张牌。
concuss.text_en: When this hits a hero, if this has {p} greater than its base, they discard a card.

condemn_to_slaughter.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次符文剑士攻击获得+3力量。
你可以摧毁你控制的一个光环。若如此做，每位对手摧毁其控制的一个光环永久物。
再动
condemn_to_slaughter.text_en:
Your next Runeblade attack this turn gets +3{p}.
You may destroy an aura you control. If you do, each opponent destroys an aura permanent they control.
Go again

conduit_of_frostburn.type_zh: 冰 法师 装备·手臂
conduit_of_frostburn.text_zh:
瞬间——摧毁霜燃导管：本回合你使用的下一张具有造成秘法伤害效果的牌获得“当此牌对英雄造成秘法伤害时，摧毁其军械库中的一张冻结的牌。”
镇压1
conduit_of_frostburn.text_en:
Instant - Destroy Conduit of Frostburn: The next card you play this turn with an effect that deals arcane damage gains "When this deals arcane damage to a hero, destroy a frozen card in their arsenal."
Quell 1

confidence.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，摧毁此牌，然后本回合你使用的下一张攻击牌不能被超过2张非阻挡牌防御。
confidence.text_en: At the start of your turn, destroy this, then the next attack card you play this turn can't be defended by more than 2 non-block cards.

confront_adversity.text_zh:
仅当攻击的操控者本回合摧毁过一个活力衍生物时，此牌才能防御该攻击。
刃碎
confront_adversity.text_en:
This may only defend an attack if the attack's controller has destroyed a Vigor token this turn.
Blade Break

conquer_the_icy_terrain.text_zh: 当此牌命中英雄时，该英雄可以支付2点资源。若该英雄不支付，你可以摧毁其军械库中的一张冻结的牌或其控制的一个被冻结的非英雄永久物。
conquer_the_icy_terrain.text_en: When this hits a hero, they may pay {r}{r}. If they don't, you may destroy a frozen card in their arsenal or a frozen non-hero permanent they control.

conqueror_of_the_high_seas.text_zh:
当此牌命中英雄时，摧毁其军械库中的所有牌。每有一张以此方式摧毁的牌，创造一个金币衍生物。
涨潮——若你资源区中有2张或更多蓝色牌，此牌获得+1力量和再动。
conqueror_of_the_high_seas.text_en:
When this hits a hero, destroy all cards in their arsenal. Create a Gold token for each card destroyed this way.
High Tide - If there are 2 or more blue cards in your pitch zone, this gets +1{p} and go again.

consign_to_cosmos_shock.type_zh: 闪电 法师 行动·光ning 瞬间
consign_to_cosmos_shock.text_zh:
凝合
从任意坟场中放逐X张瞬间和/或光环牌，X为本回合你造成的秘法伤害量。
//
对任意目标造成1点秘法伤害。
consign_to_cosmos_shock.text_en:
Meld
Banish X instant and/or aura cards from any graveyard, where X is the amount of arcane damage you've dealt this turn.
//
Deal 1 arcane damage to any target.

constella_contemplation.type_zh: 闪电 法师 瞬间
constella_contemplation.text_zh:
创造一个沉思衍生物。
星落——若本回合有一张瞬间牌被置入你的坟场，对目标英雄造成1点秘法伤害。
constella_contemplation.text_en:
Create a Ponder token.
Starfall - If an instant card has been put into your graveyard this turn, deal 1 arcane damage to target hero.

constella_flowslide.type_zh: 闪电 法师 瞬间
constella_flowslide.text_zh:
创造一个闪电流转衍生物。
星落——若本回合有一张瞬间牌被置入你的坟场，对目标英雄造成1点秘法伤害。
constella_flowslide.text_en:
Create a Lightning Flow token.
Starfall - If an instant card has been put into your graveyard this turn, deal 1 arcane damage to target hero.

constella_tiara.text_zh: 瞬间——支付2点资源，摧毁此牌：防止本回合接下来将对你造成的1点伤害。若你以此方式防止伤害，创造一个沉思衍生物。
constella_tiara.text_en: Instant - {r}{r}, destroy this: Prevent the next 1 damage that would be dealt to you this turn. If you prevent damage this way, create a Ponder token.

constella_uplift.type_zh: 闪电 法师 瞬间
constella_uplift.text_zh:
重置你控制的一根法杖。
星落——若本回合有一张瞬间牌被置入你的坟场，对目标英雄造成1点秘法伤害。
constella_uplift.text_en:
{u} a staff you control.
Starfall - If an instant card has been put into your graveyard this turn, deal 1 arcane damage to target hero.

constella_waves.type_zh: 闪电 法师 装备·手臂
constella_waves.text_zh: 瞬间——横置你的英雄，摧毁此牌：增幅1
constella_waves.text_en: Instant - {t} your hero, destroy this: Amp 1

construct_bank_breaker.text_zh:
若你装备了一件扳手武器，将其和你控制的3张超频驱动器转化为破银行家，然后装备破银行家。
再动
construct_bank_breaker.text_en:
If you have a wrench weapon equipped, transform it and 3 Hyper Drivers you control into Bank Breaker, then equip Bank Breaker.
Go again

construct_nitro_mechanoid.text_zh:
将目标机械师头部、胸部、手臂、腿部、武器装备和你控制的3张超频驱动器转化为硝基机甲。若你没有，则此牌无效。
再动
construct_nitro_mechanoid.text_en:

cut_through_the_facade.text_zh:
此牌不能被光环防御。
当此牌命中英雄时，你可以摧毁其控制的一个光环。
cut_through_the_facade.text_en:
This can't be defended by auras.
When this hits a hero, you may destroy an aura they control.

Target Assassin attack action card with contract gains +3{p}.

cutting_couriers.text_en: When your sword attack hits, you may destroy this. If you do, the attack gets go again.

cutting_retort.text_en: When this attacks a hero, you may pay up to {r}{r}{r}. Destroy that many aura tokens with different names they control. If you do, this gets +1{p} for each aura destroyed this way.
